properties.name: Curiosity localized traverse (PLACES localized_pos, ROVER rows)

provenance.dataset: MSL Rover PLACES bundle, product localized_pos.csv v42.0 (urn:nasa:pds:msl_places:data_localizations:localized_pos.csv)
provenance.crs: Longitude/latitude per PLACES SIS v1.2-A section 4.4.2.4: lon = easting/3396190*180/pi; lat_pc = northing/3396190*180/pi; lat_pd = atan(tan(lat_pc)*(3396190/3376200)^2). Geometry = [lon, lat_planetocentric, elevation] to match the project HiRISE basemap (Trek curiosity_hirise_mosaic, EPSG:104905 Mars ocentric); lat_planetodetic_deg is in properties for Cesium.Ellipsoid.MARS.
provenance.processing: node scripts/curiosity-convert.mjs — kept ROVER rows with sol >= 0 (SITE rows duplicate positions), sorted by sol/sclk/site/drive/pose.
provenance.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSS/PLACES team, PDS Geosciences & Imaging Nodes
